approved: Australian Local Power Agency (Consequential Amendments) Bill 2021

The bill amends existing clean energy legislation to establish the Australian Local Power Agency as a sister agency to ARENA and the CEFC, forming a trinity to drive renewable energy investment and ensure regional communities benefit.
